meta.name: ecommerce-copywriter
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者在需要为多品类商品创作或优化营销图片文案时使用。自动提炼核心卖点，生成带emoji的吸睛标题与直击痛点的场景化正文，一键产出高转化率电商文案，省时省力大幅提升商品点击与购买转化！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提炼商品卖点，生成带表情的吸睛营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要为电商商品撰写吸引人的标题和描述
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling product copy from key selling points
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write product titles and descriptions for online stores

howto.what: 提供产品名称、卖点等信息后，Claude 会生成电商图片文案：带 emoji 的标题加四段正文（痛点、产品介绍、卖点、情感升华），输出 Markdown，也能优化已有文案。
howto.when: 当你提出电商文案创作或文案优化需求时触发；也可在需要为某类商品（如智能家居、数码配件等）写营销图片文案时进入。

say.text: 帮我给这款智能睡眠眼罩写一篇电商图片文案：卖点是科学遮光、智能感应光线。
say.note: 它会先问产品信息，再按四段结构输出 Markdown 文案。

say.text: 把这段现有文案优化一下：标题加 emoji，痛点写得更突出。
say.note: 按标题、正文、emoji、结构给出优化版。

say.text: 用环保生活类模板，给可降解餐具套装写一篇电商文案。
say.note: 套用环保生活类模板生成标题和正文。

howto.what_en: Give it product details and selling points, and Claude writes e-commerce image copy: an emoji headline plus four paragraphs (pain point, product intro, selling points, emotional close) in Markdown. It can also rewrite existing copy.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for e-commerce copy writing or copy optimization, or need marketing image copy for a product category such as smart home or digital accessories.

say_en.text: Write e-commerce image copy for a smart sleep mask; key points: light blocking.
say_en.note: It asks for product info, then outputs four-paragraph copy.

say_en.text: Optimize this copy: add emoji to the title and sharpen the pain point.
say_en.note: Returns an optimized title, body, emoji and structure.

say_en.text: Use the eco-friendly template to write copy for a biodegradable tableware set.
say_en.note: Uses the eco-friendly template for the headline and body.
